name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: The Classic Margherita Pizza is a golden-brown, wood-fired pizza topped with melted white cheese, red tomato sauce, and fresh green basil leaves, presented on a wooden serving board with a side of tomato sauce and olive oil.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image shows a dish of Chicken Tikka Masala, which is a bowl of orange-red sauce with chunks of grilled chicken and garnished with green herbs, served with white rice and naan bread on the side.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: The 'Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu' is a vibrant and appetizing dish featuring golden-brown tofu cubes and a colorful medley of broccoli, carrots, and snap peas, all coated in a glossy brown sauce, served in a white bowl alongside a side of white rice and chopsticks.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing is a vibrant mix of lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, red onion rings, Kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese, presented in a white bowl with a silver spoon and accompanied by a small glass jar of dressing and a lemon wedge on a wooden table.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: This is a bowl of spaghetti aglio e olio, a classic Italian pasta dish featuring a tangle of cooked spaghetti tossed with golden-brown garlic, sprinkled with grated Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley, and served in a white bowl.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: The image shows a glazed salmon fillet on a wooden board, garnished with dill, mustard seeds, and lemon, and served with a fork and a side of glaze.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: The Tomato Basil Soup is a vibrant red-orange soup garnished with fresh basil leaves and herbs, served in a blue-rimmed bowl and surrounded by various ingredients including tomatoes, garlic, and spices.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: The 'Pad Thai' dish is a stir-fry noodle dish garnished with large shrimp, bean sprouts, green onions, and cashews, presented on a large plate surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: The image displays a plate of crispy, golden-brown chickpea falafel surrounded by sliced red onions, green onions, lemon, garlic, and parsley, with bowls of chickpeas, tahini sauce, and spices arranged around it.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: The image shows four tacos filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded cheese, lettuce, salsa, guacamole, sour cream, and diced tomatoes, arranged on a plate and surrounded by various toppings and condiments.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image shows a 'Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak', a grilled ribeye steak cooked to medium-rare, sliced into thick strips, and served in a dark pan with butter and thyme sprigs.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric is a vibrant, reddish-brown lentil stew garnished with fresh cilantro, sliced onions, halved cherry tomatoes, a slice of lime, and a sprinkle of spices, served in a ceramic bowl on a beige cloth napkin.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: The dish, 'Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice', is a beautifully presented meal featuring a glazed cod fillet on a bed of white rice, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, and served with a side of soy sauce and additional rice in small bowls.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: The Caribbean Jerk Chicken is a platter of four roasted chicken pieces, glazed with a shiny sauce and seasoned with herbs and spices, arranged on a wooden platter with sliced limes and surrounded by small bowls of rice, sauce, salt, and beans.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The 'Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta' is a vibrant dish featuring penne pasta mixed with roasted red and yellow cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and grated cheese, presented on a rustic plate.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish 'Paneer Butter Masala' is a vibrant orange-red curry with tender paneer cubes, onions, and herbs, presented in a large bowl and accompanied by naan bread and basmati rice.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: The Falooda dessert drink is a layered, visually appealing treat consisting of red jelly cubes and noodles at the bottom, topped with white cream and a pink syrup drizzle, garnished with cherries, rose petals, and mint leaves in tall glasses.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: The Shakshuka is a vibrant dish featuring eggs poached in a rich, red sauce filled with sliced red and green peppers, onions, and herbs, presented in a black skillet.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: The 'Cuban Black Beans and Rice' dish is a simple yet flavorful meal consisting of a mound of white rice surrounded by dark brown beans, garnished with sliced garlic and green leaves on a white plate.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The dish 'Beef Bulgogi' is a plate of thinly sliced, medium-rare beef, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, served on a bed of onions.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The Spanish Paella Valenciana is a vibrant, saffron-infused rice dish garnished with succulent chicken pieces, halved cherry tomatoes, and sprigs of rosemary, all presented in a traditional large, shallow pan.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: The 'Tom Yum Goong' is a steaming hot, vibrant orange soup served in a white bowl, garnished with cilantro, sliced red chilies, and a lime wedge, and featuring large shrimp, mushrooms, and lemongrass in a clear broth.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: The 'Chicken Caesar Salad' is a visually appealing dish featuring grilled chicken breast slices on a bed of romaine lettuce, croutons, and halved cherry tomatoes, all tossed in a creamy sauce and topped with shaved parmesan cheese.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: The Moussaka is a layered eggplant casserole with a rich meat sauce, melted cheese, and a golden-brown crust, garnished with fresh herbs and presented in a metal baking dish.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Shoyu Ramen with noodles, sliced meat, green onions, black sesame seeds, and soft-boiled egg halves in a brown broth.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: The 'Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta' is a visually appealing dish featuring cooked shrimp, green beans, and lemon slices atop a bed of yellow fettuccine noodles, all presented on a light-colored ceramic plate surrounded by ingredients like lemons, garlic cloves, and seasonings.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: The Ratatouille is a vibrant and colorful dish, presented in a white bowl, featuring a medley of sliced vegetables including zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, and red peppers, garnished with fresh herbs and surrounded by whole vegetables and seasonings.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: The dish 'Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt' features two pan-seared salmon fillets with crispy skin, served with a side of white yogurt sauce garnished with dill and spices, accompanied by lemon wedges and fresh dill on a rustic plate.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The 'Thai Green Curry with Vegetables' is a vibrant and colorful dish featuring a medley of vegetables, including zucchini, bell peppers, and snow peas, alongside tofu, all served in a rich green curry sauce over a bed of white rice.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: The image depicts a traditional Thai dessert, 'Mango Sticky Rice', presented on a blue plate with a bowl of white glutinous rice topped with a vibrant orange sauce, diced mango, and green leaves, accompanied by sliced mango and small bowls of ingredients.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: The 'Herbed Quinoa Salad' is a vibrant mix of cooked quinoa, sliced cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, and fresh parsley, presented in a white bowl with a fork on the side and garnished with lemon wedges and a small bowl of olive oil.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: The Beef Shawarma Wrap is a large, neatly wrapped pita filled with sliced beef, lettuce, tomatoes, onions, and cucumbers, accompanied by various sauces and seasonings.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: The 'Pesto Chicken Bake' is a dish featuring four grilled chicken breasts on a bed of pasta, topped with melted cheese, pesto sauce, and cherry tomatoes, served in a baking dish with a side of pesto in a wooden spoon.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: The 'Baked Eggplant Parmesan' is a layered dish featuring breaded and baked eggplant slices topped with melted cheese and tomato sauce, presented in a baking dish.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: The Moroccan Chickpea Stew is a vibrant, red-brown stew made with chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and garnished with fresh cilantro, served in a decorative brown ceramic bowl.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The 'Crunchy Cabbage Slaw' is a fresh salad presented in a blue-rimmed bowl, comprising shredded green cabbage and carrots, with visible black pepper seasoning, arranged on a brown surface alongside various ingredients and utensils.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: The 'Ceviche de Pescado' is a vibrant and fresh dish featuring raw white fish marinated in citrus, mixed with sliced red chili peppers, red onions, and cilantro, and garnished with a lime wedge.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The dish consists of a plate of stir-fried chicken, basil leaves, and red chili peppers in a savory sauce, served alongside a portion of white rice.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The Caprese Salad consists of alternating slices of red tomatoes and white mozzarella cheese, garnished with green basil leaves and drizzled with a dark sauce and light-colored oil, all presented on a white plate.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The Pumpkin Risotto is a creamy rice dish topped with diced pumpkin, thinly sliced red onions, and melting butter, presented in a large pan surrounded by ingredients like whole pumpkins, shallots, salt, and broth.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: The 'Garlic Butter Shrimp' dish features succulent shrimp cooked in a rich, golden sauce infused with garlic, parsley, and herbs, served in a black skillet.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The Roasted Red Pepper Hummus is a creamy beige dip garnished with a spiral of olive oil, chickpeas, and sliced red peppers, surrounded by red chili peppers and coarse salt, served in a dark bowl alongside pita bread and various seasonings.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: The image shows a plate of garlic naan, a type of Indian flatbread, garnished with garlic cloves and herbs, and served with a small bowl of garlic butter.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The 'Butter Chicken' dish is a vibrant red curry with tender chicken pieces, onions, and green leaves, presented in a blue bowl and garnished with various herbs and spices.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: The Coconut Curry Lentil Soup is a vibrant orange-yellow, creamy lentil soup garnished with dried red chilies, onions, herbs, black seeds, and a swirl of white cream, served steaming hot in a brown ceramic bowl.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: The 'Gyro Wrap' is a toasted pita stuffed with sliced meat, tomato, cucumber, red onion, and tzatziki sauce, presented on a wooden board with fresh ingredients and seasonings in the background.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: A roasted chicken, broken down into portions, is presented on a brown ceramic platter, garnished with lime slices and herbs, and surrounded by additional lime slices, garlic cloves, and spices.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: The 'Mango Salsa Chicken' dish features four grilled chicken breasts on a white plate, topped with a vibrant mango salsa made with diced mango, red onion, red pepper, and cilantro, and served with lime wedges.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: The dish "Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip" is a visually appealing arrangement of rice paper rolls filled with shrimp, carrots, and vegetables, accompanied by a bowl of creamy peanut dip garnished with sesame seeds and mint, all presented on a round wicker platter with various fresh ingredients.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: The 'Beef Nachos' dish is a vibrant and appetizing platter of tortilla chips smothered in melted cheese, seasoned ground beef, beans, sliced jalapeños, and cherry tomatoes, topped with a dollop of sour cream.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: The 'Herbed Chicken Skewers' are grilled chicken cubes threaded onto skewers, garnished with rosemary and onions, and served on a plate with lemon wedges and a drizzle of oil.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: The 'Coconut Shrimp Curry' is a vibrant and appetizing dish featuring succulent shrimp, sliced onions, bell peppers, and green chilies in a rich yellow curry sauce, presented in a large pan.

name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto
directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.
Deglaze with wine; add broth gradually until creamy.
image_description: The 'Herbed Mushroom Risotto' is a creamy, off-white risotto dish topped with sautéed mushrooms, fresh herbs, and black pepper, served in a brown bowl and surrounded by various ingredients such as cheese, herbs, and mushrooms.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: The 'Lemon Ricotta Pancakes' are a golden-brown pancake topped with a dollop of yellow spread and powdered sugar, surrounded by various ingredients and toppings including butter, lemon, flour, and condiments in small bowls.

name: Egg Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in a wok; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then eggs.
Season with soy sauce and scallions.
image_description: The 'Egg Fried Rice' is a savory dish of stir-fried rice, mixed vegetables including peas and carrots, and scrambled eggs, topped with four sunny-side-up eggs and garnished with green onions and black sesame seeds, served in a dark pan.

name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
directions: Mix batter with cabbage.
Cook on a griddle; top with meat and flip.
Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
image_description: The Okonomiyaki is a savory pancake topped with shrimp, shredded lettuce, mayonnaise, red sauce, and a light dusting of green powder, served on a round plate with dipping sauces on the side.

name: Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon
directions: Cook pasta; reserve some pasta water.
Toss with lemon zest, juice, herbs, and olive oil.
Add a splash of pasta water; finish with parmesan.
image_description: The 'Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon' is a vibrant and appetizing dish featuring penne pasta tossed in a green herb sauce, topped with grated cheese, fresh basil leaves, and lemon wedges, served in a shallow ceramic bowl.

name: Coconut Rice with Beans
directions: Simmer coconut milk with garlic powder; stir in beans and cilantro.
Serve over rice.
image_description: The image shows a dish of 'Coconut Rice with Beans', presented in a large metal bowl, surrounded by various ingredients, including white rice, black beans, coconut milk, and spices, with the cooked mixture featuring a creamy white sauce and visible beans, herbs, and spices.

name: Baked Cod with Tomato and Olive
directions: Place cod in baking dish; top with tomatoes, olives, and garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil; bake at 200°C (400°F) for 12-15 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
image_description: The baked cod is presented on a plate surrounded by halved tomatoes, green and black olives, and garlic cloves, all bathed in a savory olive oil sauce and garnished with parsley.

name: Seared Tuna Niçoise
directions: Sear tuna to desired doneness.
Boil beans and potatoes; assemble with eggs and olives.
Dress with lemon vinaigrette.
image_description: The Seared Tuna Niçoise is a visually appealing dish featuring seared tuna steaks, boiled potatoes, green beans, olives, and boiled eggs, arranged artfully on a plate with lemon wedges and garnished with fresh herbs.

name: Harissa Chickpea Bowl
directions: Roast chickpeas with harissa 15-20 minutes.
Serve over quinoa with fresh vegetables and lemon yogurt sauce.
image_description: The 'Harissa Chickpea Bowl' is a vibrant and appetizing dish featuring couscous topped with harissa-glazed chickpeas, sliced cucumbers, diced tomatoes, and a dollop of white sauce, all garnished with green onions and herbs, presented in an ornate bowl.

name: Salmon with Dill and Mustard Glaze
directions: Mix glaze with mustard, dill, and honey.
Brush on salmon; bake or pan-sear until flaky.
image_description: Two grilled salmon fillets are served on a dark baking sheet, topped with a glaze and dill, and surrounded by herbs and seasonings.

name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Avocado
directions: Toss greens with avocado and tomatoes.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and serve.
image_description: The 'Butter Lettuce Salad with Avocado' is a fresh mix of green lettuce leaves, halved cherry tomatoes, and diced avocado, seasoned with spices and presented in a white bowl with a fork, ready to be dressed with a yellow vinaigrette being poured from a small pitcher.

name: Eggplant Caponata
directions: Sauté eggplant until soft.
Add vegetables and simmer with vinegar and sugar until thick.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
image_description: The Eggplant Caponata is a vibrant and savory Sicilian relish, presented in a rustic bowl, comprising tender eggplant, juicy tomatoes, crunchy celery, and green olives, all harmoniously mixed in a rich sauce.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
directions: Toast bread; mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Poach eggs; place on toast and serve.
image_description: The dish consists of toasted bread topped with mashed and sliced avocado, two poached eggs, and is seasoned with various spices and accompanied by lemon wedges on the side.

name: Herbed Tomato Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 20 minutes; blend until smooth.
Stir in cream and herbs; season and serve.
image_description: The 'Herbed Tomato Soup' is a vibrant red soup garnished with sliced tomatoes, basil leaves, thyme sprigs, and a swirl of cream, presented in a black bowl surrounded by fresh ingredients and seasonings.

name: Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes
directions: Boil gnocchi until floating; drain.
Toss with pesto and halved tomatoes; top with parmesan.
image_description: The dish 'Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes' is a visually appealing plate of gnocchi tossed in a vibrant green pesto sauce, topped with halved cherry tomatoes and sprinkled with shredded cheese, garnished with fresh basil leaves.

name: Paneer Butter Fry
directions: Sauté onion in butter; add paneer and brown.
Add tomato paste and spices; simmer with a splash of cream.
image_description: The 'Paneer Butter Fry' dish is a vibrant red curry with golden-brown paneer cubes, onions, and tomatoes, topped with a dollop of white cream and spices, served in a dark bowl.

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Brussels Sprouts
directions: Toss sprouts with oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 20-25 minutes; finish with lemon zest.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of roasted Brussels sprouts with lemon slices and garlic, seasoned with various spices and herbs, presented in a brown ceramic bowl.

name: Paneer Tarsi with Spinach
directions: Sauté onion and tomato; add spices.
Stir in spinach until wilted; add paneer and simmer briefly.
image_description: The 'Paneer Tarsi with Spinach' is a vibrant and flavorful dish featuring white paneer cubes, halved cherry tomatoes, and onion curls, all mixed with fresh green spinach leaves in a dark blue pan.

name: Rendang Beef
directions: Simmer beef with coconut milk and rendang paste with aromatics until tender and thickened.
image_description: The 'Rendang Beef' is a rich and flavorful stew featuring tender chunks of beef in a thick, orange-brown sauce, garnished with fresh green leaves and presented in a large, earthy-toned bowl surrounded by various spices and ingredients.

name: Chili Con Carne
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add beef and brown.
Add spices, tomato sauce, and beans; simmer 25-30 minutes.
image_description: The 'Chili Con Carne' dish is a vibrant, thick stew presented in a black pot, garnished with green leaves and visible chunks of red peppers, ground meat, and kidney beans, surrounded by various ingredients and spices.

name: Persian Jeweled Rice
directions: Cook rice; mix with saffron and jeweled mix of nuts and dried fruits.
Fluff and serve.
image_description: The Persian Jeweled Rice is a vibrant and ornate dish, featuring a bed of white and yellow rice topped with a colorful arrangement of dried fruits, including cranberries, orange peel, and raisins, as well as almonds and prunes, all presented on an intricately designed gold-rimmed platter.

name: Moroccan Lentil Soup (Harira)
directions: Sauté onions, garlic; add tomato paste and spices.
Add lentils and chickpeas with water; simmer until tender.
Finish with lemon juice and herbs.
image_description: The Moroccan Lentil Soup, or Harira, is a vibrant, thick stew featuring chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, and onions in a reddish-brown broth, garnished with parsley and presented in a black pot.

name: Thai Red Curry with Chicken
directions: Sauté curry paste in oil; add chicken to sear.
Pour in coconut milk; add vegetables and simmer until cooked.
Finish with basil and fish sauce.
image_description: The 'Thai Red Curry with Chicken' is a vibrant, red curry dish featuring tender chicken pieces, sliced red and green peppers, and green peas, all garnished with fresh basil leaves and served in a ceramic bowl.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic and chili in olive oil; add tomato sauce.
Toss with pasta and garnish with parsley.
image_description: The Pasta Arrabbiata is a vibrant and spicy dish featuring penne pasta tossed in a rich tomato sauce, garnished with halved cherry tomatoes, red chili peppers, and fresh parsley, all presented in a rustic brown bowl.

name: Cranberry Walnut Salad
directions: Toss greens with cranberries, walnuts, and cheese.
Drizzle with vinaigrette.
image_description: The 'Cranberry Walnut Salad' is a fresh mix of greens, sliced cucumbers, crumbled white cheese, and red cranberries, topped with walnuts and a drizzle of dark sauce, served in a ceramic bowl.

name: Corn Chowder
directions: Sauté onion in butter; add potatoes and corn.
Add milk and simmer until thickened; season.
image_description: The Corn Chowder is a creamy, yellow soup garnished with chopped scallions, served in a bowl with a spoon and surrounded by ingredients like corn, potatoes, and seasonings.

name: Eggplant Yakitori Skewers
ingredients: Soy glaze: soy sauce, sugar, mirin
directions: Skewer eggplant chunks; brush with glaze.
Grill until tender; garnish with sesame seeds.
image_description: The Eggplant Yakitori Skewers are grilled eggplant slices threaded onto wooden skewers, glazed with a dark sauce, and sprinkled with sesame seeds, arranged on a plate with some sauce pooling at the bottom.

name: Chana Masala
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 15-20 minutes.
image_description: The 'Chana Masala' dish is a vibrant and aromatic chickpea curry, presented in a large bowl and garnished with sliced tomatoes, onions, and fresh herbs, surrounded by an assortment of spices and ingredients.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients; whisk in wet ingredients until smooth.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: The image depicts a stack of golden-brown buttermilk pancakes in a skillet, topped with poached eggs and drizzled with syrup, arranged on a plate.

name: Mango Lassi
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Chill and serve.
image_description: The 'Mango Lassi' is a creamy white yogurt drink garnished with spices, topped with a vibrant orange mango puree, and served in a clear glass surrounded by ingredients like diced mango, sugar, and cardamom pods.

name: Pesto Pasta with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
directions: Cook pasta; drain.
Toss with pesto and sun-dried tomatoes; top with parmesan.
image_description: The image shows a plate of pesto pasta with sun-dried tomatoes, surrounded by ingredients such as cheese, tomatoes, and spices, and presented with a fork on a decorative table setting.

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
directions: Form patties and brown in a pan; set aside.
Make gravy with mushrooms, onion, flour, and broth; return patties to pan and simmer.
image_description: The Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy is a hearty dish featuring a browned beef patty topped with sautéed mushrooms and served in a rich brown gravy, accompanied by a side of white rice and onions, and garnished with chopped green onions.

name: Simple Garlic Herb Salmon
directions: Season salmon; sear in a pan with garlic and herbs.
Finish with lemon juice and serve.
image_description: The 'Simple Garlic Herb Salmon' dish features two cooked salmon fillets garnished with herbs, garlic cloves, and peppercorns, presented in a skillet with a lemon slice and surrounded by additional ingredients on a wooden table.

name: Gnocchi with Sage Butter
directions: Cook gnocchi until floating.
Brown butter with sage; toss with gnocchi and parmesan.
image_description: The dish "Gnocchi with Sage Butter" is a plate of pan-seared gnocchi topped with sage leaves and grated cheese, surrounded by ingredients like cheese blocks, olive oil, and grated cheese in small bowls.

name: Shredded Beef Tostadas
directions: Slow-cook beef with spices until tender; shred.
Top tostadas with beef and toppings.
image_description: The image shows a plate of 'Shredded Beef Tostadas' consisting of four crispy corn tortillas topped with shredded beef, lettuce, diced tomatoes, sour cream, and herbs, served with lime wedges on a dark plate.

name: Chili Lime Grilled Corn
directions: Grill corn until charred; brush with butter.
Sprinkle chili powder and drizzle lime juice; season.
image_description: The 'Chili Lime Grilled Corn' features four grilled corn cobs on a slate plate, garnished with lime slices, chili peppers, and minced garlic, and accompanied by bowls of red spice powder, green sauce, and corn kernels.

name: Herbed Rice with Peas
directions: Cook rice with peas; stir in greens and butter.
image_description: The 'Herbed Rice with Peas' is a bowl of cooked white rice mixed with green peas and chopped green herbs, presented in a large ceramic bowl and surrounded by various ingredients and garnishes.

name: Gulai Ayam (Indonesian Curry Chicken)
directions: Sauté curry paste; add chicken and coconut milk.
Simmer with vegetables until cooked.
image_description: The dish is a vibrant Indonesian curry chicken stew, presented in a shallow pan with handles, featuring tender chicken pieces, sliced carrots, green beans, potatoes, and peas in a rich, yellow-orange curry sauce, garnished with chopped herbs.

name: Spicy Peanut Noodles
directions: Cook noodles; whisk sauce with peanut butter.
Toss noodles with sauce and sesame seeds.
image_description: The 'Spicy Peanut Noodles' dish is a vibrant bowl of noodles topped with peanuts, sliced red chilies, green onions, sesame seeds, and seaweed, presented in a blue-rimmed bowl surrounded by various ingredients and garnishes.

name: Herbed Quiche
directions: Whisk eggs with cream and herbs.
Fill crust with cheese and vegetables; pour mixture and bake until set.
image_description: The 'Herbed Quiche' is a savory pie cut into eight slices, featuring a golden-brown crust filled with eggs, herbs, and cheese, surrounded by ingredients like cheese, eggs, herbs, and spices.

name: Baked Ziti
directions: Cook pasta; mix with sauce and meat.
Top with cheese and bake until bubbly.
image_description: The 'Baked Ziti' is a baked pasta dish featuring rigatoni pasta topped with a rich red sauce, melted white cheese, and brown meat crumbles, presented in a white baking dish surrounded by fresh tomatoes and a side of red sauce.

name: Herbed Shrimp and Grits
directions: Prepare grits as per package instructions with butter.
Sauté shrimp with garlic; stir in lemon and parsley.
Serve shrimp over grits.
image_description: The 'Herbed Shrimp and Grits' dish features a bowl of creamy grits topped with sautéed shrimp, garlic, and herbs, presented in a shallow bowl with a spoon and garnished with parsley and black pepper.

name: Duck Confit (Simple Version)
ingredients: Duck legs confit (or duck legs and fat)
directions: Crisp duck skin in a hot skillet; finish in oven until skin is golden and meat is tender.
image_description: The image shows two golden-brown duck legs, slow-cooked in a rich fat with garlic cloves, herbs, and peppercorns, presented in a rustic cast-iron pan.

name: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
directions: Mix ingredients; bake in loaf pan until a toothpick comes out clean.
image_description: The 'Lemon Olive Oil Cake' is a golden-yellow loaf cake with a crispy brown crust, cut into slices and surrounded by ingredients like lemons, olive oil, and sugar, with a smooth, moist texture and garnished with green herbs.

name: Salsa Verde Chicken Tajine
directions: Combine ingredients in a tajine or pot; simmer until chicken is cooked and flavors meld.
image_description: The Salsa Verde Chicken Tajine is a hearty stew presented in a dark-brown, handled clay pot, featuring chicken pieces, potatoes, chickpeas, green and black olives, red peppers, and onions, all garnished with fresh herbs and served in a savory broth.

name: Coconut Lime Chicken
directions: Sauté garlic and curry paste; add chicken and coconut milk.
Simmer until chicken is cooked; finish with lime juice.
image_description: The "Coconut Lime Chicken" dish is a vibrant yellow curry featuring chicken pieces, sliced limes, red chili peppers, garlic cloves, onions, and cilantro, all presented in a gray bowl on a dark blue surface.

name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cook filling with spinach and feta; stuff peppers.
Bake in sauce until peppers tender.
image_description: The image shows baked green and yellow bell peppers filled with a mixture of rice, spinach, and topped with a block of golden-brown feta cheese, garnished with fresh basil leaves, and served in a cast-iron skillet with a bed of red sauce.

name: Gado-Gado (Indonesian Peanut Salad)
ingredients: Peanut sauce: peanuts, palm sugar, tamarind, lime
directions: Arrange vegetables, eggs, and tofu on a plate.
Drizzle with warm peanut sauce and serve.
image_description: The Gado-Gado (Indonesian Peanut Salad) is a vibrant and colorful dish featuring a medley of vegetables, tofu, chickpeas, and boiled eggs, topped with a rich peanut sauce and garnished with peanuts, all artfully arranged on a decorative plate.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
directions: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
image_description: The Kung Pao Chicken is a stir-fry dish presented in a wok, featuring bite-sized chicken pieces, red chilies, and peanuts, all coated in a savory sauce and arranged artfully.

name: Mapo Tofu
directions: Brown the ground meat in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy bean paste and peppercorns, stirring until fragrant and the oil turns red.
Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: The 'Mapo Tofu' dish is a savory mixture of brown minced meat and white tofu cubes in a red sauce, garnished with green onions, served in a large pan with a wooden spoon.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The 'Beef and Broccoli' dish is a stir-fry featuring sliced beef and broccoli florets, garnished with cashews and peas, presented in a large wok with various ingredients and seasonings surrounding it.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: The image shows a plate of General Tso's Chicken, featuring crispy fried chicken pieces in a dark brown sauce with visible ginger and red peppers, served with a side of white rice garnished with red chili slices.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: The image shows pan-seared dumplings garnished with sesame seeds, served with a dipping sauce.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: The 'Hot and Sour Soup' is a savory, golden-hued soup presented in a large black pot, featuring visible ingredients like tofu, bamboo shoots, noodles, and green onions, garnished with a raw egg yolk and accompanied by various seasonings and condiments.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: The 'Chow Mein' dish is a vibrant and savory stir-fry featuring a medley of colorful vegetables, including carrots, broccoli, cabbage, and peppers, tossed with noodles and presented on a ceramic plate.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image shows three bowls of 'Wonton Soup' with a clear broth, wontons, and green onions, surrounded by various seasonings and ingredients on a wooden tray.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: The 'Honey Walnut Shrimp' dish is a vibrant and appetizing arrangement of succulent shrimp, steamed broccoli florets, and walnuts, all harmoniously presented in a blue ceramic bowl and drizzled with a creamy sauce.
